issues.issue: Is the judicial review moot, because the RPD has reopened the claim and the decision has no practical effect?
issues.applicant_position: Opposed the motion; raised concern that the RPD would not believe him. No written response was filed.
issues.respondent_position: Application is moot: the RPD has reopened the claim, so a decision would not resolve a live controversy.
issues.result_quote: a decision on the application for judicial review would not have any practical effect in solving a live controversy between the parties

issues.issue: Should the Court exercise its discretion to hear the application despite mootness?
issues.applicant_position: Raised concern that the RPD would not believe him in the reopened claim.
issues.respondent_position: Judicial economy weighs against hearing a moot case; no public interest in settling the law.
issues.result_quote: I have not identified any basis for an exercise of discretion to hear the application notwithstanding that it is moot.
